name: trigger guard
author: LizardMan
description: A worn key that fires twice plays once: on the keyboard's note keys, a second press inside the window (50 ms to start, 10 to 300) is dropped. One window per note or one for all keys, and "false releases held" keeps a note sounding through a bounce. The synth, the drums, the sequencers and USB MIDI out all get the cleaned keys. The idea is u/Andromax_sussybaka's.
